extracted.intended_audience: independent documentary/non‑fiction filmmakers seeking Sundance Film Grants or other documentary funding
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for applying to the Sundance Documentary Film Program and Sundance Documentary Fund, including the qualitative standards they look for in projects and the application materials required at different production phases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program scope / eligible work
rubrics_metrics.description: Supports non-fiction filmmakers worldwide in the production of cinematic documentaries on contemporary themes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Sundance Documentary Film Program supports non-fiction filmmakers worldwide in the production of cinematic documentaries on contemporary themes. (Established in 2002 with founding support from Open Society Foundations.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Artful film language
rubrics_metrics.description: Films supported should display artful film language.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Sundance Documentary Fund supports independent nonfiction films that display artful film language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Films should demonstrate effective storytelling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Sundance Documentary Fund supports independent nonfiction films that display... effective storytelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects should show originality in concept or execution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Sundance Documentary Fund supports independent nonfiction films that display... originality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feasibility
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications must demonstrate that the project is feasible to complete as proposed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Sundance Documentary Fund supports independent nonfiction films that display... feasibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contemporary cultural relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects should address or engage with contemporary cultural themes or issues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Sundance Documentary Fund supports independent nonfiction films that display... contemporary cultural relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience reach and connection
rubrics_metrics.description: Projects should have potential to reach and connect with their intended audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Sundance Documentary Fund supports independent nonfiction films that display... potential to reach and connect with its intended audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Demonstration of creative and storytelling intent
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions require written or visual material that demonstrates your creative and storytelling intent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Film submissions require you have written or visual material that demonstrates your creative and storytelling intent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowed production phases for submission
rubrics_metrics.description: You may submit projects at any production phase from development through post-production.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may submit at any production phase from development through post‑production. Current Sample/Rough Cut is required for Production/Post Production submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: No prior funding or fiscal sponsor required
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants do not need to have prior funding or a fiscal sponsor to apply.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You do not need any prior funding or a fiscal sponsor in order to apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision timeline
rubrics_metrics.description: Expect decisions to take approximately 3–6 months after submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While the Sundance Film Grant cycle is year‑round, decisions typically take 3‑6 months.

rubrics_metrics.name: Written Proposal (required)
rubrics_metrics.description: A written proposal is a required element of the application package.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sundance Film Grants Application Requirements: Written Proposal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposal checklist (supporting materials)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a proposal checklist to ensure required materials and supporting documents are included.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sundance Film Grants Application Requirements: Proposal Checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Line item budget (required)
rubrics_metrics.description: A detailed line item budget must be submitted; sample budget templates (PDF/Excel) are provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sundance Film Grants Application Requirements: Line Item Budget (Sample Budget: PDF / Excel).

rubrics_metrics.name: Visual samples (required)
rubrics_metrics.description: Visual samples that illustrate the project’s style and approach must be submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sundance Film Grants Application Requirements: Visual Samples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Previous directing sample (optional)
rubrics_metrics.description: A completed previous directing sample of any length or genre may be included but is optional.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sundance Film Grants Application Requirements: Completed Previous Directing Sample (any length or genre) -- optional.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current sample / rough cut (required for later phases)
rubrics_metrics.description: For projects in production or post-production, a current sample or rough cut is required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sundance Film Grants Application Requirements: Current Sample/Rough Cut (Required for Production/Post Production).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pitch materials should present documentary as an investment
rubrics_metrics.description: Business plan and pitch deck materials should highlight why the documentary is a good investment, using market and distribution data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documentary Business Plan Template: focus on why documentaries are a great investment and how to best showcase your documentary to investors. Include recent successes, emerging documentary trends, streaming and studio deals, distribution patterns, audience statistics, revenue generated for sample films, and comparable films to support projections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use business plan research to shape pitch deck
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the pitch deck leverages business plan research to showcase the project as a worthy investment opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documentary Pitch Deck: while our pitch deck template can be used for any type of film, you will use your business plan research to ensure the deck showcases your documentary as a worthy investment opportunity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial projections and comparable films
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide financial projections and comparable film data to support fundraising and investor outreach.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Financial Projections/ Comparable Films - our custom database and custom financial projections flow seamlessly for both documentaries and narrative films.
